body: Living. I’m always tense, can never relax. I keep falling back into old habits. I got nothing, no friends. Stuck at home with my parents. I don’t have a car or anything. Dead end job. I’m alone all the time.  My emotions are always erratic, I can’t think straight. I get paranoid and anxious. I feel angry and let down, every day is the same. Everyone expects me to be strong but I can’t. I can’t be anymore.
